handover_report.prepared_for: Next AI engineering agent / continuation session

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI / EverythingApp is a local-first AI-powered file brain and evidence-backed knowledge workspace that indexes local files, extracts document content, builds source-backed Wiki pages, supports Ask/Search workflows, and safely enables governed operational actions.
executive_summary.current_phase: Local MVP Wiki evidence workspace milestone reached. The project has moved beyond a file indexer/chatbot into a content-first operational encyclopedia with source verification UX.
executive_summary.latest_confirmed_direction: The Wiki must behave like a content-first encyclopedia/book/blog reader built from actual local document content. Source verification, citations, evidence snippets, preview drawers, source cards, and chunk-level navigation are now core product direction, not optional polish.
executive_summary.major_milestone: Phase 1 — Advanced Wiki UX & Source Verification Layer is effectively complete. Citation-to-source-to-chunk evidence inspection is implemented in the user UI.
executive_summary.current_bottleneck: The frontend evidence UX foundation is strong. The next bottleneck is Phase 2 durable knowledge engine architecture: persisted chunk/source tables, semantic relations, stronger extraction, embeddings, AI clustering, and deeper backend knowledge object persistence.
executive_summary.handover_timing_reason: A new handover is required because the project architecture and product identity significantly evolved after the previous Wiki milestone handover. The evidence inspection workflow is now a stable milestone and should become the new continuation baseline.

hard_rules: Work directly on main unless user explicitly changes policy.
Do not introduce long-lived feature branches.
Always give exact file paths when discussing or changing code.
Do not expose destructive/operator workflows in the ordinary user UI.
Keep the official user UI safe and non-destructive.
Keep dangerous planning/execution/recovery/admin controls isolated in admin/operator interfaces.
Permanent purge remains disabled in the local MVP under NO_PERMANENT_PURGE_IN_LOCAL_MVP.
Move/rename actions must remain preview + approval gated.
Do not claim production readiness without local tests/build validation.
user_preferences: When code changes are discussed, always mention exact file and folder paths.
When full file code is requested, provide complete final code, not partial snippets.
Ask only when information is truly insufficient; otherwise proceed with best effort.
Use the project roadmap/docs as the authority when evaluating progress.

user_ui.status: Functional and significantly improved. Contains Start, Explore, Wiki, and Ask sections. Wiki now includes content-first reading surfaces, source cards, source preview drawer, citation/chunk evidence navigation, async rebuild panel, and operational verification actions.
user_ui.role: Safe user-facing AI knowledge workspace. No destructive operator workflow should be exposed here.

admin_ui.status: Exists as separate admin/operator UI. Continue to host operator workflows here rather than in the safe user UI.
admin_ui.role: Operator/admin control center for planning, action governance, recovery, provider/source settings, audit inspection, and future automation governance.

legacy_static_ui.status: Still exists, but current active user/admin UI work is in apps/everything-ai-ui. Do not build new user-facing MVP features in services/api/public unless deliberately maintaining legacy/admin compatibility.

known_limitations: Latest frontend changes need local typecheck/build validation after this handover commit.
Source Preview Drawer depends on source.chunks being present in backend Wiki output; it gracefully shows no chunk-level preview if chunks are unavailable.
Chunk refs in markdown currently normalize to source ref for source-card lookup and full ref for drawer chunk scrolling.
Windows Explorer Reveal in folder still does not reliably select exact files for some encoded/Unicode paths. Copy path is implemented as fallback.
Wiki source chunks are not yet represented as a durable first-class SQLite table with stable IDs and page-level PDF references.
PDF page numbers are not yet reliable because extraction is not fully page-aware.
Images/tables/charts from PDFs/Excel are not yet richly extracted and embedded into Wiki article sections.
UserApp.tsx has been reduced but still contains significant state/controller responsibilities and should be further decomposed later.
